NumberFlow 0.2.3
===============
Official MIT package: https://github.com/barvian/number-flow
npm tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/number-flow/-/number-flow-0.2.3.tgz
Pinned in package-lock.json. The copyright and MIT license are preserved.

0.2.3 uses JavaScript digit positions and finite Web Animations translateY.
Unlike 0.3+ it does not require CSS mod()/round(), which are unavailable in the
current Obsidian Chromium 124 host. Uses NumberFlowLite and partitionParts,
a version-specific custom element, and fixed currency/sign spans. Only key
financial summaries animate; motion preferences and actual API support apply.
